_comment: An example draft spec, and the file shape the builder exports. Run it with: node tools/dev-server.mjs --spec=tools/example-branching-spec.json. The wording is placeholder on purpose; this file exists to demonstrate the branching fields, not to be a real assessment.

blocks.text: Placeholder scenario. A pilot has run for two quarters and the results are mixed. You have been asked what to do next.

blocks.label: Slack from your manager
blocks.text: Need a call on this by Friday. Three options on the table as far as I can see, and I do not mind which, but I do want to know why.

questions.context: Pick one. The questions after this one follow from what you choose here.

questions.prompt: Which states would you add, and what would you cut to pay for them?
What would you pivot to, and what would you stop doing?
What would you need to see before committing either way?
questions.context: This route is deliberately shorter, which is what makes Part 2 disappear from the progress bar when you take it.
